messages:
sophia: Heads-up — starting intake for Magnetar-7B bring-up. Rotary-style RoPE, unusual rotary scaling in the weights, and we saw a KV-eviction-y pattern on long-context traces. Posting quick checklist + ask for owners.

raj: ack. can you paste the failing trace?

sophia: pasted minimal repro below. observed token drop after ~2048 where kv reads return stale vectors. not sure if eviction or misaligned offsets.
```
# repro snippet (internal)
curl -s -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"magnetar-7b","input":"<long chat>... 2300 tokens"}' https://internal-infer.local/v1/complete
# logs: kv_get(index=2047) -> cache_hit, kv_get(index=2048) -> cache_miss, kv_get(index=2049) -> cache_hit
```

ana: tagging for rotary scaling check. I remember a similar appendix in the rotor PR where left-shifts caused off-by-one in position index mapping.

dave: quick questions: 1) is this on quantized artifact or FP16? 2) which backend (cuda-llama, triton, custom kernel)?

sophia: quant q4_0 and q8_0 both reproduced. backend=custom-runtime (rope-optimized kernels). also reproduced on dedicated nodes and a small hosted sample.

raj: steps I want in intake: short smoke tests + metrics to gather. we should add to checklist: tokenizer mismatch, rotary index parity, kv read/write offsets, cache-eviction policy sim, long-context batching, and per-token logprobs comparison to float baseline.

ana: +1. also add: run attention-mask race tests (concurrent decode + partial prefix cache loads).

ml-ci-bot: CI note: added job magnetar/rotary-kv-smoke -> queued (requires dedicated-gpu pool).

raj: sample commands for smoke tests (put in the thread so infra can reuse):
```
# run fp16 baseline
python infra/tests/rotary_kv_smoke.py --model magnetar-7b --dtype fp16 --ctx 4096 --iters 5
# run quant
python infra/tests/rotary_kv_smoke.py --model magnetar-7b --dtype q4_0 --ctx 4096 --iters 5
# compare logprobs
python infra/tests/compare_logprobs.py --baseline fp16 --candidate q4_0 --model magnetar-7b --prompt tests/data/long_dialogue.txt
```

dave: I'll own kernel parity check and kv offset profiler. ETA EOW if no blockers.

ana: I'll run tokenizer + rotary mapping scans and make a small fuzz harness for position indices.

raj: Product / prioritization: what's expected impact? any customer hits?

sophia: Not yet customer-facing but internal e2e with long context apps (summarization pipelines) regressed in QA. Risk: P2->P1 if we see customer reports. Recommend prioritize perf/quality triage before broad rollout.

raj: OK mark as P1 for bring-up. Owners: dave (runtime), ana (ml mapping), sophia (triage + eval harness). Add checklist items for release gating.

ml-ci-bot: magnetar/rotary-kv-smoke started on pool:dedicated-gpu-1 (job id 9876).

ops-bot: FYI capacity aware — reserving two instances for manual repro (dedicated-gpu-1) for 2 hours.

raj: Final checklist (condensed):
- run fp16 vs quant regression suite (logprobs + mle delta)
- rotary index parity check and scaling factor audit
- kv cache eviction stress (long context + interleaved shorter requests)
- kernel-level profiler for kv offsets + memory alignment
- end-to-end latency/throughput on dedicated vs hosted
- build quick canary with fallback to baseline model for hosted routes

ana: I'll drop a PR with the rotary-index fuzz and a small readme on how to run the harness.

dave: found initial culprit locally — an off-by-one in circular buffer wrap for kv pointers when ctx > 2048 + even quant rounding. pushing a debug branch now: https://phab/internal/D12345 (work in progress).

sophia: great. when you have a patch can we run the full smoke + compare job?

dave: yes, will ping here once CI passes.

raj: link tasks: create ticket in backlog with severity:P1 and link phab. I'll schedule a 30m sync tomorrow if needed.

sophia: thanks all. updating intake doc with owners and gating checklist. :white_check_mark:

ml-ci-bot: magnetar/rotary-kv-smoke job 9876 -> passed (3/3). artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-ci/magnetar/9876/

ana: ran fuzz harness against the debug branch — reduced off-by-one hits by >95%. sharing patch notes in D12345.

dave: merged fix to staging, will run the larger regression suite.

ops-bot: released canary route: magnetar-staging (2 instances) with auto-fallback to magnetar-fp16 if kv errors spike.

raj: closing intake as 'in-progress -> triaged'. reopen if any regression on canary.

sophia: thanks team.
